vehicles.general_issues: The 2.4L engine in these years is known for intake manifold gasket failures. Watch for rough idle or check engine light with P0171. Also check oil level regularly - some consume oil.

codes.P0171: Common issue on 2.4L engines. The intake manifold gasket often fails, causing a vacuum leak and lean condition. Relatively inexpensive fix if caught early.

vehicles.general_issues: The 2AZ-FE 4-cylinder engine has a known oil consumption issue. Toyota extended warranty coverage for some VINs. Check oil every 1,000 miles.

codes.P0171: Known oil consumption issue on 2AZ-FE engine can cause lean codes. Check oil level regularly.
codes.P0420: May be triggered by oil burning past piston rings and contaminating the catalytic converter.

vehicles.general_issues: The 3.5L EcoBoost can have turbo and timing chain issues at higher mileage. Listen for rattling on cold start. The 5.0L V8 is generally more reliable long-term.

codes.P0420: The 3.5L EcoBoost is known for turbo and wastegate issues that can trigger catalyst codes.

vehicles.general_issues: The N20/N26 engines have known timing chain and VANOS issues. Oil changes every 5,000 miles recommended despite longer factory intervals. Water pump and thermostat are common failures around 60-80k miles.

codes.P0171: Common on N20/N26 engines. Often caused by cracked intake boot or failing VANOS solenoid seals.
codes.P0300: Ignition coils and spark plugs are common failure points. BMW recommends replacement every 60k miles.

vehicles.general_issues: The 5.3L V8 with AFM (Active Fuel Management) can have lifter failures. Some owners disable AFM to prevent issues. Transmission shudder is also common - fluid change may help.

codes.P0420: GM issued TSB for catalytic converter issues on some 5.3L V8 engines.

vehicles.general_issues: DSG transmission (if equipped) requires fluid change every 40k miles - often skipped by owners. The 2.0T engines can have carbon buildup on intake valves. Water pump failures are common.

codes.P0171: Common causes include PCV valve failure and intake manifold flap issues.
codes.P0420: Frequent on high-mileage TDI models after emissions system modifications.

vehicles.general_issues: Head gasket failures are common on the 2.5L engine, especially if coolant changes were neglected. Watch for external oil leaks and coolant loss. CVT transmission has had reliability concerns.

codes.P0420: Head gasket issues on 2.5L engines can contaminate the catalytic converter over time.

vehicles.general_issues: The CVT transmission is a known weak point - shuddering, whining, or failure can occur. Nissan extended CVT warranty on some models. Check for transmission fluid leaks.

codes.P0171: CVT transmission issues often accompany engine codes. Check transmission fluid level and condition.

vehicles.general_issues: The 3.6L Pentastar V6 is generally reliable but has known issues with rocker arm failures on early models (2011-2013). Thermostat failures are common. Check for oil filter housing leaks.

codes.P0128: Common thermostat failure on 3.6L Pentastar V6. Usually sticks open, causing slow warmup.

vehicles.general_issues: CRITICAL: These years have an engine recall for connecting rod bearing failure that can cause engine seizure. Check NHTSA.gov with your VIN immediately if you haven't already.

codes.P0300: Engine recall for connecting rod bearing failure. Check if your VIN is covered before other repairs.

vehicles.general_issues: The 1.8L engine is reliable but can develop a cracked engine block in cold climates - Honda extended warranty for this. A/C compressor failures are common.

codes.P0171: Often caused by a dirty or failing MAP sensor on these engines.

vehicles.general_issues: Very reliable overall. Water pump may need replacement around 100k miles. Some have excessive oil consumption - check level regularly. CVT (if equipped) generally holds up well.

codes.P0420: Usually appears at high mileage. Often the actual catalytic converter wearing out rather than a sensor issue.

vehicles.general_issues: CRITICAL: The PowerShift dual-clutch automatic transmission has major reliability issues - shuddering, slipping, and failure are common. Ford faced lawsuits over this. Manual transmission models are fine.

codes.P0171: Often unrelated to the transmission issues - check for vacuum leaks.

vehicles.general_issues: The 5.7L and 6.4L HEMI engines are generally reliable. Watch for lifter tick on cold start (often normal). The 8-speed automatic can have shift quality issues - software updates may help.

codes.P0300: On HEMI engines, often caused by worn spark plugs (16 total on HEMI). MDS (cylinder deactivation) can also cause issues.
codes.P0420: Aftermarket exhaust modifications can trigger this code.

vehicles.general_issues: The 2.4L engine has known issues with timing chain wear and excessive oil consumption. GM issued extended warranty for some. Check oil frequently - do not wait for the oil life monitor.

codes.P0171: Often related to the PCV system or timing chain issues on the 2.4L.
codes.P0420: High oil consumption can foul the catalytic converter over time.
